description: Source code for the home screen UI of a Flutter-based chess application, including widgets for game controls, move history, and display components.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main StatelessWidget for the application's home screen, containing the layout for the chess board and controls.

classes.name: _ControlsBar
classes.description: Widget for rendering game control buttons such as new game, undo, redo, and AI move.

classes.name: _DifficultySelector
classes.description: Dropdown widget to select AI difficulty levels.

classes.name: _ResultBanner
classes.description: Displays the game's outcome and restart option when the game concludes.

classes.name: _MoveHistoryPanel
classes.description: Widget displaying the list of moves made during the game.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for each widget, composing the layout and interactions.
